item.content:encoded:
Company Overview

Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With tens of millions of customers worldwide using products such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

Job Overview

As an Enterprise Account Executive in Intuit’s Accountant segment, you own the full sales cycle with the largest accounting firms in the country with complex multi-partner workflows. You carry quota-bearing responsibility for net new revenue for Intuit Accountant Suite (IAS) and Intuit AI Tools, and you are accountable for moving deals from first conversation to signed agreement to active deployment. You operate as the IAS and AI specialist within Intuit’s enterprise model. Firm Engagement Managers own the overall firm relationship; your lane is product depth, demo excellence, and driving the Forward Deploy motion to close.

This is an enterprise sales motion which means you will have multiple stakeholders including CEOs, CTOs, transformation leaders, managing partners, IT leads, operations directors, and domain experts and your success depends on your ability to navigate those organizations, build multi-threaded relationships, and close. You will run tailored product demonstrations, lead the pre-engagement qualification process for Intuit’s Forward Deploy co-build model, and quarterback a complex post-sale motion that puts Intuit’s product and implementation teams inside the firm building AI-powered workflows.

You are the tip of the spear on Intuit’s enterprise push into the accounting and tax professional market. This segment represents one of Intuit’s highest-priority growth opportunities, and this role is central to capturing it.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Pipeline and Territory Management

  • Own and develop a named account territory of enterprise-tier accounting and tax firms, building a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, industry events, and partner introductions.
  • Maintain a pipeline sufficient to achieve and exceed individual quota at all times; own CRM hygiene with rigor and accuracy across every account and stage.
  • Segment and prioritize your territory by firm size, technology maturity, staffing model, and strategic alignment with IAS and Intuit AI while always working the highest-leverage targets first.
  • Track buying signals across your territory, firm growth, software renewals, partner turnover, AI readiness, and engage at the right moment.
  • Report pipeline health and deal progress through Sales Interlock and updates flow directly to Intuit’s SLT and CEO. Your number is visible at the top of the house.

Complex Deal Execution

  • Lead the full sales cycle end-to-end: discovery, needs assessment, solution design, demonstration, proposal, negotiation, and close on deals that routinely span multiple stakeholders.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, Marketing, Product, Channel, and SLT, to align internal resources and accelerate deal execution inside complex, multi-party opportunities.
  • Run high-quality, workflow-first demonstrations of IAS and AI workflows tailored to each firm’s service lines, staff structure, and current technology stack. This is a consultative motion, not a feature walkthrough.
  • Build and manage multi-threaded relationships within each account: managing partners for vision alignment, IT and operations leads for technical validation, and domain experts for workflow buy-in.
  • Quarterback each deal through Intuit’s internal qualification, contracting, and onboarding processes ensuring a seamless handoff from close to activation with zero gaps.

IAS and Intuit AI Tool Adoption

  • Drive post-close activation of IAS and Intuit AI tools within each enterprise account tracking usage, surfacing adoption risks, and engaging firm leadership when adoption stalls.
  • Identify and close expansion opportunities within existing accounts: new service lines, additional seats, deeper AI deployments, and ProTax attach to existing IAS relationships.
  • Build relationships and partnerships that outlast the initial transaction.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS, financial technology, or professional services software with a proven track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Demonstrated success closing large deals: you understand how to build value, manage a sales cycle, and close against multiple competing priorities inside the buyer’s organization.
  • Experience running consultative product demonstrations for professional services buyers. You tailor the demo to the buyer’s workflow, not to your product’s feature list.
  • Strong deal management and forecasting discipline: you build the pipeline deliberately, maintain accurate CRM data, and forecast with confidence, not optimism.
  • Executive presence and communication skills: able to engage credibly with managing partners, firm CTOs, and C-suite stakeholders at the largest professional services firms.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and modern sales productivity platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to gain cross-functional alignment within Intuit and the Accounting firm.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to accounting firms, CPA firms, or tax professionals. You understand firm structure, partnership dynamics, decision-making timelines, and what ROI means to a managing partner.
  • Prior experience selling or positioning AI-powered workflow automation tools and the ability to translate agentic AI capability into firm-level productivity and revenue impact.
  • Understanding of the accounting firm technology market and competitive landscape and how enterprise firms evaluate ERP and technology decisions.
  • Experience managing or participating in a co-build, Forward Deploy, or professional services engagement model alongside a technical delivery team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs. Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is: California Remote (Bay Area) $189,000 – $256,000.

Intuit is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

item.content:encoded:
Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify’s data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You’ll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and, just as importantly, invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you’re energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
  • Take accountability for the team’s delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure.
  • Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale.
  • Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies.
  • Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team’s services.
  • Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team’s capabilities.

Who You Are

  • You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility.
  • You have a track record of investing in engineers’ careers, running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression.
  • You’re comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale. You don’t need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team.
  • You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity.
  • You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones.
  • You’ve worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren’t in the same room.
  • You’re excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work, whether that’s accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

Where You’ll Be

  • This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still, it allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to support you in any way we can.
